initialExam.title: UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist Examination 2026
initialExam.description: Combined Geo-Scientist Examination for recruitment in Geological Survey of India and Central Ground Water Board. Prelims held Feb 8, 2026; Mains held June 20, 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: M.Sc. in Geology/Applied Geology/Marine Geology or equivalent
initialExam.syllabus: Geology Paper-I, II, III covering Physical Geology, Structural Geology, Mineralogy, Petrology, Stratigraphy, Paleontology, Hydrogeology, Engineering Geology.
initialExam.examPattern: 3 papers (written) + Interview. Total written: 600 marks. Interview: 200 marks.
initialExam.jobRole: Geologist in Geological Survey of India, Central Ground Water Board
initialExam.careerGrowth: Geologist → Senior Geologist → Director → Additional Director General.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit upsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form with geology qualifications 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: Field Allowance, DA, HRA, Medical, Pension
